GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away evenly. Niggled early & raced @ rear Two Wide (7L from lead). Pushed to stay in touch with bunch midrace & chasing Two Wide (8L from lead) on home turn. Weakened Two Wide in straight. # Couldn't keep up
Jumped Ok well back Settled Down 2nd last 8 Lengths 600m 9th 8 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 9th Middle Of Track only held ground Straight # back/never in it
Jumped Ok joint lead 3 Wide , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l off, found little and plodded home # Eq led 3 Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 5l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 3l off, found little and kept on one pace # weak run home

Began OK. Not pushed early & raced 3rd Two Wide (2L from lead). Tracked leaders Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 550m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & outsprinted in last 200m. # didn't quicken

Best away. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (1L from lead) early . Worked to race 2nd Two Wide midrace & =lead Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed to quicken =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pressured 3 Wide @ 250m & outgunned in last 150m. Vetted - laceration near hind. # Worked/tried hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination found the mare to have sustained a laceration to its near hindleg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up 1 length clear, headed passing 200m, 1 length off & 2nd @ 100m , kept on b4 swamped final 50m # led/headed 200m

Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to chase 3 Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Outsprinted 3 Wide in straight. Vetted clear. # Never likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Jockey reported she anticipated mount leading the event, however, after beginning only fairly, mare failed to display sufficient early speed and settled at the rear of the small field. She stated mount travelled fairly in this position throughout early & middle stages, however, when placed under pressure approaching home turn, the mare failed to quicken & was only one paced. She added that mount performs best when able to lead outright & dictate terms. Post race vet no abs.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Quickly drove Through to Lead by 1.5l. cuddled Turn . Straightened Up 1.5l Clear of winner, 2 Horse War . Battled On Well but Collared 50m. beat rest comfortably # led winner, sound
Jumped Ok , sat 3rd Two Wide 3 Lengths 600m, copped bump and bit unbalanced Straightening Up , weakened last 200m # weakened 200m
Jumped Well sat handy 1-2 Lengths off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 2-3 Lengths off, battled on one pace to the line without threatening # basic
Jumped Ok emerged to Lead by 2l. Same into Straight and Battled On Well but Collared 150m. tired Quickly thereon # led clear, tired
